projects.title: Intern AI & Data engineer
projects.description: AI-driven platform for B2B prospecting and business opportunity matching – Final Year Project (PFE)
projects.summary: Developed an end-to-end AI-driven platform for B2B prospecting and business opportunity matching, aimed at identifying relevant market signals and connecting them with suitable profiles or services.
key_contributions: Designed and implemented a full data pipeline for collecting, cleaning, and normalizing heterogeneous data from multiple web sources.
Built NLP-based processing modules for information extraction, entity recognition, and semantic analysis using embeddings.
Developed a multi-dimensional scoring engine combining rule-based logic, machine learning signals, and LLM-based reasoning to ensure both performance and explainability.
Designed an agent-based AI architecture with specialized agents for search, analysis, and generation, coordinated through a Human-in-the-Loop validation process.
Implemented semantic matching using vector search and reranking techniques to improve relevance and accuracy of results.
Orchestrated workflows using n8n to automate data processing and AI pipelines.
Deployed the system on cloud infrastructure with a modular and scalable architecture.

projects.description: License Key Generation and Validation System
projects.summary: Developed a secure system for software activation key management to control access, duration, and validity of licensed software.

Created a management dashboard for administrators to generate, monitor, and revoke activation keys.
Integrated encryption techniques to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of license data.
Simulated real-world use cases of licensing in distributed software systems.
Focused on security, reliability, and usability for both developers and end-users.
